setupText: Connect to app.flowplan.org or enter the address of your own Flowplan instance.
setupHint: You can add more instances later in the app settings under “Profiles”. Switch there or by pressing and holding the app icon: “Switch profile”.
label: Instance address
empty: Please enter the address of your Flowplan instance.
invalid: This is not a valid address.
https: Without HTTPS, only addresses in your local network work – like http://192.168.1.20:3000, http://nas or http://nas.local. Every other address needs HTTPS.
httpName: On iPhone and iPad, iOS allows plain HTTP only for IP addresses, names without a dot (nas) and .local names. Enter the instance’s IP address, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:3000 – or set up HTTPS.
httpWarning: Passwords and all content cross the network unencrypted – fine only on a network you trust. Without HTTPS there are also no passkeys, encrypted spaces, voice notes on pages or, on Android, the offline copy; notifications from an instance in the local network usually don’t arrive. For real use, please set up HTTPS.
unreachable: Nothing answers at {server}. Check the address and your internet connection.
redirect: {server} redirects to {detail}. Please enter that address.
notFlowplan: There is no Flowplan running at {server}.
offlineHint: Is your device online and on the same network as the instance – or connected to the VPN you use to reach it? Flowplan keeps trying in the background.
offlineNoCopy: There’s no offline copy on this device. To open your pages without a connection, turn on offline use in Flowplan under Settings → Offline & devices while you’re connected.
offlineCopyFailed: The offline copy on this device couldn’t be opened. Open Flowplan once with a connection to renew it.
offerText: Then you can read and edit them without a connection too. This takes about 20 MB, plus your pages. You can change it any time in Flowplan under Settings → Offline & devices.
offlineCopyManaged: The offline copy is managed in Flowplan: Settings → Offline & devices.
offlineCopyNone: There’s no offline copy of this profile on this device.
offlineCopyIncomplete: Offline copy on this device, not complete yet
offlineCopyAt: Offline copy on this device, updated {age}
addProfileText: Enter the address of another Flowplan instance. Each profile has its own sign-in.
profilesText: Notifications, widgets and the timer belong to the active profile.
signInForeign: This sign-in was not started in this app or belongs to another instance. Please start it again with “Sign in with a passkey” or “Sign in with SSO”.
signInNoBrowser: The browser for signing in could not be opened. Check that a browser is installed and enabled, then try again.
notificationsOn: New mentions, comments and reminders appear as notifications and as a number on the app icon.
notificationsOff: Notifications are turned off for Flowplan.
notificationsUnavailable: This instance does not send notifications to the app.
appLockText: Unlock Flowplan with {method} when the app opens.
appLockUnavailable: No unlocking with Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint or passcode is set up on this device.
biometrics: Face ID, Touch ID or passcode
widgetsText: Each widget shows one thing and has its own settings (long press → edit): tasks to check off, today, favorites, counters, journal and habits, time, mentions, forms, quick capture. They update in the background. Administrators also get the state, live numbers and storage of the instance.
liveActivityText: A running timer appears on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island.
timerNotificationText: A running timer stays visible as a notification.
forget: Sign out and remove the profile
forgetConfirm: The app signs out of {server} and removes the profile “{name}”. Your data stays on the server.
notSignedInText: Wrong instance or a typo? Change this profile’s address or remove it.
removeProfileConfirm: “{name}” is removed from the app. Nothing changes on the server.
widgetCheckFailed: Couldn’t check off – open in Flowplan
widgetLocked: Protected by the journal PIN – unlock it in Flowplan
widgetEncrypted: End-to-end encrypted – readable in Flowplan only
widgetSetup: Edit the widget and choose a page
widgetGone: No longer available – edit the widget
captureNoTarget: Nowhere to capture to. Create a database in Flowplan.
scanText: The camera finds the pages by itself. Flowplan recognises the text and saves everything as a searchable PDF.
scanSearch: Search for a page or database
micDenied: Flowplan may not use the microphone. Allow it in the system settings.
channelActivitiesText: Focus, meetings, imports, voice memos and incidents
activitiesText: Focus, voice memos and the timer always appear while they run.
shareSkipped: Not taken (photos and PDFs only, at most 10): {names}
shareTooOld: This Flowplan instance does not take shared files yet – text and links work.
tileText: A Quick Settings tile opens quick capture, also from the lock screen.
updateText: A new version of the Flowplan app is available. It downloads in the browser; then open the file to install it – your sign-in and data stay.
certUntrusted: {host} presents a certificate this device does not trust – for example a self-signed one or one of your own certificate authority.
certNameMismatch: Caution: the certificate was not issued for {host}.
certExpired: Caution: the certificate has expired or is not valid yet.
certTrustHint: Only trust it if the fingerprint matches your server's. Flowplan then trusts exactly this certificate, and only for {host}. Alternatively, install your certificate authority's certificate in Android's settings (Security → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate).
certChanged:
{host} presents a different certificate than the one you trusted. This can be a renewal – or someone trying to intercept the connection. That's why Flowplan does not load the page.

Before:
{old}

Now:
certIosHint:
For Flowplan to connect, install your certificate authority's certificate (or this server certificate) on the device and trust it:
1. Download it (for example in Safari or via AirDrop) and install it in Settings → General → VPN & Device Management.
2. Turn on full trust for it in Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings.
Then connect again.
certIosNoSubjectAltName: iOS requires the server's name in the certificate's Subject Alternative Name – this certificate has none.
certIosOtherName: iOS requires {host} in the certificate's Subject Alternative Name.
certIosTooLong: iOS refuses server certificates that are valid for more than 825 days.
certRefused: Flowplan does not connect to {server}: the server's certificate is not trusted.
certPinnedText: For {host}, Flowplan trusts exactly this certificate (valid until {to}):
certPinRemoveConfirm: Flowplan will then only connect to {host} if the device trusts its certificate – or you trust it again.
approveSetUpAgain: Approving from the notification is being set up again – please decide here.
approveOtherInstance: This approval belongs to another instance. Switch to it to decide.
channelRemindersText: Tasks due today – when the instance sends no notifications.
voiceOnDevice: On this device with Apple's speech recognition – the recording does not leave the device for it.
voiceSpeechDenied: Without permission for speech recognition the recording is inserted without text.
voiceSpeechFailed: Speech recognition did not work – the recording is inserted without text.
voiceFailed: The recording could not be handed over.
